description: This file defines an interface and a class for securely storing session tokens in an Android application. It uses EncryptedSharedPreferences backed by Android's Keystore for encryption, providing methods to save, load, clear, and check for tokens.

classes.name: EncryptedPrefsTokenStore
classes.description: A Kotlin class implementing TokenStore that uses EncryptedSharedPreferences for secure token storage, with methods to save, load, clear, and check tokens.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves session tokens securely into encrypted shared preferences.

methods.name: loadOrNull
methods.description: Loads session tokens if present; returns null if not.

methods.name: hasTokens
methods.description: Checks if tokens are present in storage.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate EncryptedPrefsTokenStore with application context.
